title: ManifestAsset
description: One immutable media object (currently audio), matching Kotlin ManifestAsset(id, key, sha256, bytes, mimeType, durationMs?, sampleRateHz?, credits?). 'key' is resolved against the configured HTTPS content origin only; it must be a safe relative path with no traversal.

key.description: Parent transport convention: filename is derived from the asset id (audio-<assetId><ext>), never the original source filename. No '..'/'.' path segments, percent-encoding, query strings, colons, or backslashes are possible under this pattern because every segment must start with an alphanumeric character.
